title: Panels should remain mouse-accessible while window is full-screen (not just when maximized)
line: With "Remain active when windows are fullscreen" turned on in Screen Edges, pushing the pointer to a panel's screen edge now reveals the panel over a fullscreen window, and its widgets can be clicked.
explanation: KWin moves the active fullscreen window into a layer above docks, and its screen edge code blocks a panel's edge while a fullscreen window is active even when "Remain active when windows are fullscreen" is on, so no panel can ever be shown over a fullscreen window. Vlad's three open MRs fix this together: KWin stops migrating fullscreen windows between layers and stops blocking panel edges (also dropping the slide effect's dock restacking workaround); plasma-workspace adds an Occlusion helper (is an area covered by a window / by a fullscreen window) and a PanelView.wantsToBeHidden property; Panel.qml uses them so a panel covering a fullscreen window hides itself and is revealed from its screen edge like an auto-hide panel. With the Screen Edges option off (the default) the panel stays hidden over fullscreen windows, so nothing changes for people who don't want it.

commits.message:
Don't migrate fullscreen windows between layers

Active fullscreen windows were moved above docks, so panels could not be
revealed over them even with the screen edge set to stay active. Keep
them in their layer, unblock panel edges and drop the slide workaround.

BUG: 426840

shell: Let panels hide themselves over fullscreen windows

Panels had no way to ask to be hidden other than auto-hide and dodge
mode. Add an Occlusion helper reporting whether a window, or a full
screen one, covers an area, and a PanelView.wantsToBeHidden property.

BUG: 426840

desktoppackage: Hide panel when covering a fullscreen window

Once fullscreen windows stop covering panels, a panel needs to get out
of their way. Use the Occlusion helper to hide it over a fullscreen
window, so it can be revealed from the screen edge like auto-hide ones.

BUG: 426840

media.caption: Master, auto-hide panel, "Remain active when windows are fullscreen" on: pushing the pointer into the bottom edge over a fullscreen window shows nothing.
Same steps with the patches: the auto-hide panel slides in over the fullscreen window and hides again when the pointer leaves.
Master, default always-visible panel: pushing into the bottom edge over a fullscreen window shows nothing.
With the patches the always-visible panel hides over the fullscreen window and appears when the pointer is pushed into the edge.
The revealed panel works over the fullscreen window: clicking the clock opens the calendar.
